jobs.name: Site Signal weekly re-scan
jobs.prompt: No-agent job: runs scripts/weekly_rescan.sh, which scans every owner_verified site in ~/SiteSignal/sites.yaml with all three scanners and prints a short diff only when a score dropped >=3 points, a new critical/serious issue appeared, or a scan failed. Empty output is a silent tick. Cron runs never open or merge PRs (SPEC.md 5.5).
jobs.paused_reason: enabled only after the owner says yes (SPEC 5.5)
